question: Should durable local marketplace watches be accepted as a core feature that advances the global shared SQLite schema and establishes its downgrade/upgrade policy?
rationale: Repository policy requires explicit user discussion and acceptance before an agent advances a SQLite schema version, and this choice determines whether the persistence belongs in core at all.

options.title: Sponsor the core schema contract
options.body: Accept marketplace watches as core shared-state data, define the supported upgrade/downgrade behavior, then request a rebase and fresh exact-head validation.

options.title: Keep the capability outside core state
options.body: Pause this implementation and pursue an external/plugin-owned design if core should not own persistent marketplace-watch history.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core schema contract
recommendation.body: Accept marketplace watches as core shared-state data, define the supported upgrade/downgrade behavior, then request a rebase and fresh exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the global state database owner boundary rather than the contributor’s proposed implementation.
